model: fair = (book mid before the move + book mid now) / 2; the model assumes half of a move is an overreaction. Edge is measured against the executable price (YES ask, or 1 - YES bid for NO) and Kalshi's published taker fee 0.07 * C * P * (1 - P) with the schedule's default multiplier M = 1: this module works offline from the snapshot, which carries no per-series fee_multiplier field (the trading engine and the paper ledger read it from GET /series; see the Flagged for Review page for the PDF-vs-API disagreement this follows).

model_inputs.fee: 0.07 * C * P * (1 - P), Kalshi published taker fee
model_inputs.reference: the order book only; both ends of every comparison are book mids so a traded price is never compared with a book quote
